not_covered.text: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz says that the Israel Defense Forces has killed 4,000 militants who took part in the Hamas-led attacks on Israel on October 7, 2023.
A ship sinks of the coast of Bulgaria after being struck by a drone.
Nairobi Hospital steps up its infection-control measures, tracing, and staff monitoring following Kenya's first imported case of Ebola.
The Daily Mail reports that a second person has died from a pneumonic plague outbreak that contains Yersinia pestis.

The faculty of Cornell University are reportedly preparing a no-confidence vote against the university's administration, including its president, Michael Kotlikoff, over its handling of rape allegations from 2024.
Riots break out in Liège, Belgium, following a day of student protests, resulting in damaged shops and destroyed bus shelters in the city center.
